title.narrative: UNDP Technical Assistance to the Final Beneficiaries of the EIB-funded Ukraine Recovery Programmes

description.narrative: The UNDP Technical Assistance for the Ukraine Recovery Programme (URP and URP-III) is a 24-month initiative (January 2026–December 2027) funded by the European Investment Bank (EUR 6 million). It is designed to ensure that EIB-financed recovery investments in Ukraine are delivered efficiently and transparently. In response to the unprecedented destruction caused by the ongoing war, UNDP aims to support efficient and transparent infrastructure rehabilitation while building local capacity, ensuring that no one is left behind and applying build back better principles. The Project ensures that investments are delivered in full compliance with the EIB Environmental and Social (E&S) Standards, and the EIB Guide to Procurement (GtP).

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).

The Implementing Partner shall ensure that all of its obligations set forth under the section entitled “Legal Context and/or Risk Management Standard Clauses” are passed on to each responsible party, subcontractor and sub-recipient and that all the clauses under this section entitled “Risk Management” are included, mutatis mutandis, in all sub-contracts or sub-agreements entered into further to the Project Document
